caption:
Turn a multi-day leak hunt into a 30-minute job: show up, pinpoint the leak, move on to the next job.

Tracer gas is 5% hydrogen and 95% nitrogen, non-toxic, non-flammable and eco-friendly. Its tiny molecules pass through soil, concrete and tile, so the sensor reads them above the leak. Pressurize the line to 1.5–4 bar (20–60 psi), within its normal working pressure and without draining it, walk the area like a metal detector, and follow the readings to the highest point.

It works underground (even 10 ft deep), under concrete slab, tile and wood, in walls, and in pool and spa plumbing. Unlike a thermal camera, it detects the gas at the leak itself, not just where water has gathered.

Less damage, a faster job, and a result your client can trust.
